name: Storybook cottage — fittings and finish kit
prompt:

User explicitly requests names/IDs on sheets and packedparts; labels must be outsideobjectsilhouettes, no watermark. Everycell contains one distinctcomponent with readablefront/depth/attachment face, realisticproportions andstraightconstructionedges; no fusedneighbors, distortedextrusions, theatrics, scene background or extraunnamedparts. Consistentmediumdetail, no thinunreadablemicrofiligree. Allsizesareproposals, cellsindependentlyscaled. Title "B12-DETAIL-001 — STORYBOOK COTTAGE — FITTINGS AND FINISH KIT". EXACT COMPONENT INVENTORY, noadditionalcells:
B12-DETAIL-001-D01 — Carved beam bracket: One curved golden-brown oak corbel, source leaf-scroll carving, flat vertical backing and horizontal bearing seat; complete underside.
B12-DETAIL-001-D02 — Gable bargeboard: One straight oak fascia length with repeating carved scalloped leaf edge and thin gilt highlights; squarecut ends, flat back; do not bendthewholeboard.
B12-DETAIL-001-D03 — Arched window insert: Complete round-topped carved oak window frame with restrained gold leading, warm amber/softlavender glass; sill, frame depth and rear edge visible; no extra wall or flowerbed.

B12-DETAIL-001-D06 — Window box planter: Empty rectangular carved timber trough with supportbrackets, visible inner cavity and drainagebase; no new flower species, plants fromGEN-13 added later.
B12-DETAIL-001-D07 — Scalloped roof tile strip: Three tidy overlapping rows of blue/violet scalloped slate shingles, coherent aligned repeats, thin restrained gilt edges, whole rectangular strip with visible thickness and back; no melting or irregular giant petals.
B12-DETAIL-001-D08 — Roof ridge finial: One small gilded star/leaf finial on modestsocket stem with flat mount; short cottage crest, not palace tower crown.
B12-DETAIL-001-D09 — Chimney pot: Warm cream/rosebrick short squareterracotta chimney pot with visible hollow mouth and lip, restrained sourcecreambanded shape; no smoke, no gianttower.
B12-DETAIL-001-D10 — Foundation corner block: One L-shaped warmivory ashlar plinth corner, matchingstraight runthickness, simple bevel/drip profile, square end joins, full underside; not elaboratepalacecapital.
B12-DETAIL-001-D11 — Porch post and brace: One slender carved oak post with small capitalblock and visible curving sidebrace, woodjoinery, flatbottom/topbearing, restrainedgilt; no surroundingwall/roof attached.
B12-DETAIL-001-D12 — Crown sign bracket: One complete curledoak/brass wallbracket supporting a small circular indigo sign with simple goldcrown relief, as source. Flatwall plate, actual hangring and smallgapbetweenboard andarm, no lettering or extra lantern.
source_fidelity: Source vocabulary preserved; unseen backs, joins, dimensions and woodland gapobjects proposed; not exact recovered geometry
review_notes: All twelve named fittings are distinct and fully framed. Cream stone, carved oak, blue-violet tiles, restrained gold and crown/leaf motifs follow the reviewed cottage family. No new lamp, bench or flower design is added.

D04 is a shutter pair, not evidence of separate meshes; its combined arch and hinges must fit D03/S01. Bracket backs, porch bearings, tile overlap, chimney bore, foundation joints and sign suspension require modelling review.

D08 uses a fleur/leaf crest within the source vocabulary. Use either a baked tile material or added D07 tile geometry, avoiding duplicate surfaces. The planter is empty so existing plants can be reused.
